title: AN EVALUATION OF LLM CODE GENERATION CAPABILITIES THROUGH GRADED EXERCISES

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the LLM's success rate in solving curated coding challenges across 8 different programming languages (including popular, niche, and legacy languages) and correlating the performance disparities with the popularity and availability of training data for each language (measured by GitHub pushes).

Measuring the LLM's coding performance against the publication date of the challenges and the number of existing human completions to quantify the impact of solution leakage and training data contamination.
